title: Hospital ward roster for one week
proves: the policy values are whole numbers, and min_rest_hours is at least the specification value 11
every roster entry holds the certification its shift type requires, valid on the shift date
a certification is valid on its expiry date, and a missing expiry date is not valid
a person on approved leave is never rostered, the last leave day included, and a requested leave does not block
between two shifts of one person there are at least min_rest_hours hours, and no two shifts overlap
the hours of a person in a week stay within the contract maximum
each slot gets at least its minimum staff and lead holders, and not more than its maximum staff
a person works in one ward per day
the search needs one backtrack: the greedy first choice for Monday night in W1 leaves W2 without a lead
a demand that no roster can meet is reported as infeasible, and an exhausted budget is reported as not proven
the decision evidence names the strongest rule and the reason for every person who is left out, or not_needed when no rule excludes the person
